summary: Deduped discussion signals: vendor product moves (AWS OpenSearch, Google Gemini, Anthropic Muse, Grok), operator workflows (Raycast MCP, agent auto-merge, Docker sandbox handoff), and infra/security signals (sandboxing study, MCP repo, AgentSense challenge, Arizona probe). | Vendor-only shard: prioritize two security GHSA advisories, OpenAI/Cisco Shirudo launch, Microsoft Foundry and AWS Bedrock product deltas, plus E2B and Mistral operator/infra signals. | GitHub OSS signals: multiple vendor releases (Vercel, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic) plus rising infra/tools for MCP, sandboxes, security, evaluation and agent workbenches. Many high-star repos but several items are repo-only and need independent corroboration. | Registry/package snapshot: active agent infra and editor workflows. Notable: OpenAI ChatGPT VS Code extension, Amazon ECS agent image, Vercel eval playground, rising local/shared memory and sandbox tooling; security scanners and eval harnesses present but need community corroboration.
